messages:
maya: just finished rolling v3.4.2 to the canary group (10%) at 17:40 PT. can folks run quick post-deploy sanity and metrics checks? tagging @calvin @leo :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded — job #deploy/8765 — commit a1b2c3d — targets: canary(10%). duration: 2m12s. logs: https://ci.internal/deploy/8765 :rocket:
calvin: on it. running the smoke script now (`scripts/deploy/smoke_canary.sh`) — will paste quick results in a min.
leo: quick health endpoint checks: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://canary.api.internal/health` => `200 0.092` for 5 samples. p50 ~90ms, p95 ~210ms. no spike in 5m.
sophie: UX sanity: did a handful of flows in the canary UI. no visible regressions, attachments upload ok. :white_check_mark:
calvin: smoke script output (abbrev):
```
> smoke: start
> login -> ok
> generate -> ok (avg 130ms)
> embeddings -> ok
> spot-check responses for hallucination -> pass
> smoke: end
```
calvin: also ran `make smoke-checks` which runs the basic throughput test — QPS steady, error rate 0.02% during run.
leo: metrics quick queries: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="canary",code!~"5.."}[1m]))` shows expected traffic. errors at 0.01-0.03% band. latency heatmap looks normal. no neon alerts.
maya: rollback readiness: tag `v3.4.1` still present, `deployctl rollback --to v3.4.1 --dry-run` returns OK. ops playbook step 3 (db migrations) is marked N/A for this release.
calvin: i'll keep the canary at 10% for 30m, then bump to 50% if no regressions. if anything pops, i'm ready to cut traffic and rollback.
leo: added a temporary alert: `CanaryHighP95` — triggers if p95 > 500ms for 5m. team paging -> @oncall.
ops-bot: Alert policy updated: CanaryHighP95 (threshold 500ms / 5m) — applied by leo.
sophie: logging note: dropped one debug line earlier that was noisy, removed in this patch — no log bloat now.
maya: thanks all. if you see anything odd ping here — otherwise i'll promote to 50% after the 30m watch. leaving this thread open for another 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
calvin: ack. i'll post final status at +30m.
leo: ack — I'll monitor dashboards and trace samples.
maya: (closing note) if we do rollback, please include `--preserve-metrics` flag so dashboards stay comparable.
calvin: noted. :thumbsup:
